license_evidence.scope: Laguna-M.1 model weights and materials in the official repository

access_boundary: This record represents the April 2026 Laguna M.1 release at Hugging Face commit 2bf8a4ab6d2e8e1e0d92a41318532a0fee1640d6 (last modified 2026-07-14), covering base, BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 variants, together with the poolside/laguna-m.1 API model. Later Laguna generations, the Poolside Chat product, and community quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated 225B flagship checkpoint with base, FP8, and NVFP4 variants under Apache-2.0
First-party inference API with platform key issuance
tradeoffs: 225B total parameters need multi-GPU serving for self-operation
Version identity rests on repository commits with base, post-trained, and quant variants to spell out
